description:
Implement the five Metadata method handlers per draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-01 §3:

- handle_metadata_get (§3.2) — thin wrapper over jmap_server::handlers::handle_get::<Metadata, B>
- handle_metadata_changes (§3.3) — CUSTOM: §3.3 adds filterRelatedType:String|null and filterMetadataType:String[]|null arguments beyond the standard /changes. Filtering applies to the returned created/updated/destroyed arrays but NOT to the state token. Must consume these args before delegating to handle_changes, then post-filter the response arrays.
- handle_metadata_set (§3.1) — Standard /set with full create/update/destroy semantics. Cookie-cut from handle_principal_set in jmap-sharing-server. Backend reports server-side uniqueness, maySetPrivate gating, quota, and relatedType validation via BackendSetError::SetError (alreadyExists / forbidden / overQuota / invalidProperties). Handler is generic — does NOT enforce semantics itself.
- handle_metadata_query (§3.4) — thin wrapper over jmap_server::handlers::handle_query::<Metadata, B>
- handle_metadata_query_changes (§3.5) — thin wrapper over jmap_server::handlers::handle_query_changes::<Metadata, B>

Inline #[cfg(test)] unit tests using a minimal MockBackend (cookie-cut from sharing-server's test_support pattern). Oracle for each test: cite spec section in doc comment.

## Acceptance
- cargo test -p jmap-metadata-server (unit tests pass)
- cargo clippy -p jmap-metadata-server -- -D warnings clean
- cargo doc -p jmap-metadata-server --no-deps clean
- All 5 method handler doc comments cite the relevant draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-01 section
- handle_metadata_changes correctly filters created/updated/destroyed by filterRelatedType and filterMetadataType when present; state token remains unfiltered per §3.3

## Out of scope
- Memory backend (.3.4)
- Real cross-handler integration tests against memory backend (.3.4)

## Depends on
JMAP-06zp.3.2
title: Implement Metadata/* method handlers in metadata.rs
